Quick technical summary from ops:
- Root cause signal: cross-tenant spike that exceeded our per-pool soft-affinity thresholds; autoscaler reacted but delay allowed queueing of token-state in the pool. One tenant produced a sudden long-history attention pattern that increased KV-cache pressure and degraded per-request throughput.
- Current status: throttling rule partially engaged; queue depth reducing but 95th still above SLA for last 8 minutes.
- Immediate mitigations we are doing (live):
  • Route FinCo traffic to quantized fallback model (q8) in the same VPC to reduce per-token latency by ~35% (risk: minor model-perf delta).
  • Increase per-tenant hard concurrency cap to prevent spillover (temporary).
  • Evacuate two low-priority test instances from that GPU pool (30m ETA to drain).

ETA: we expect 15–25 minutes to see 95th percentile back under SLA after the fallback route finishes warming (we are warming now). I will post a pool snapshot in 5 minutes (pool_snapshot_20260521.png).
